pages: Welcome, traveler!
You've just stepped into Reza's world.
Reza is a Computer Engineer and Unity Developer — a sharp-eyed ISTJ who reads patterns like a detective and logs bugs like a bounty hunter.
He builds games in C#, crafts backends with Python & Django, ships Telegram bots, and is currently leveling up in Machine Learning.
Explore the world to uncover his projects, experiments, and skills.
Every path leads somewhere different in his journey.
Take your time. There's a lot to discover!
Want to get in touch, or see the work behind the world?
Pick a link below — click it, tap it, or press its number key.
"Where's Reza? Honestly, I have no idea.
Probably in his cave creating something.
Or debugging a single line of code for three hours. You know how it is."
"Yeah, I'm Sajjad. Reza's best friend.
We go all the way back to high school.
We ended up at different universities for Computer Engineering, but honestly? We probably talked online more than most people do in person."
"Don't worry, I'm not lost.
I know exactly where I am.
...Probably."
"Me and Reza go way back.
After high school, we both went off to study Computer Engineering, but we stayed glued to Telegram the whole time.
We basically grew up on the same compiler errors."
"Nice portfolio, though.
I helped.
Emotionally. Mostly by just chatting with him while he coded at 3 AM."
"He's an ISTJ, you know. Checks every detail twice.
Me? I check once."
"Twenty-five, single, and he still owes the military a visit.
But hey — a 16.5 GPA and a GitHub full of side projects?
Yeah. The guy's doing alright."
"Okay, okay, you've heard the whole story. Twice.
At this point you know Reza better than his own mother does."
"Go on, explore. The fire's not going anywhere.
And neither am I."
"Grrr... oh! Sorry. Hello there.
Don't mind the flag. It's the Lion and Sun, an old emblem of Persia.
I carry it with pride. And it only gets heavy after the first hour."
"Yes, I'm a bear. Yes, I can talk.
No, I don't eat portfolios.
But I did eat the last of Sajjad's snacks."
"Reza showed me his projects. Games, bots, backends, machine learning...
I told him: that's a lot of work for one human.
He said it's only a lot if you sleep."
"Fun fact: the lion on my flag holds a sword and the sun rises behind it.
Meanwhile, I just hold a stick and hope the wind is kind."
"I like it here by the campfire.
Good fire, good company, and fireflies that don't try to run away from me.
...Most animals do, strangely."
"You've heard all my stories. Twice.
I'm a bear of few words. Okay, many words. But now they're finished."
"Go on, explore.
I'll keep the flag up high. And the fire warm."
